app.name: Janssen Identity Platform
app.one_liner: An open source, modular IAM platform providing OAuth/OpenID Connect, FIDO2, SCIM, and policy decision capabilities with cloud-native deployment support.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide overview of identity services, health status, and quick access to core components like auth server, FIDO2, and config API.

rust_commands.name: send_health_check
rust_commands.purpose: Send periodic health checks from Cedarling to the lock server to ensure distributed coordination reliability.
